listing.name: spanish translation
listing.summary: En resumen: Necesito ayuda para editar un par de archivos .jar (compilados en JAVA) que contienen gran cantidad de texto a traducir (por ej. el tutorial). Lo he intentado pero "in game" da error. (No tengo ni idea de JAVA)
listing.aiSummary: Provides an unofficial Spanish translation for the game files.

description:
hi
Im spanish, and my english is very limited. So I need translate some games if i want to play them. And I do it.
So I began translating starsector months ago.
But, after translating all .json .csv .skin and .java files I have hit an insurmountable obstacle for me. There are two jar compiled files that I dont know how to edit.
"starfarer_obf.jar" "starfarer.api.jar"
These files contain a large amount of text to be translated. And I'm thinking of abandoning the project unless someone can help me because I don't know anything about java.
If someone could explain to me how to edit them step by step I would be very grateful and I would not have to throw away many hours of work.
Thanks for your time. Regards

pdt.- Prácticamente todo lo traducible salvo estos archivos está ya traducido.
